# Himanshu Gunwant

> Developer · Builder · Student @ IIIT Tiruchirappalli. Minimalist portfolio and writing by Himanshu Gunwant.

## About

Computer Science undergraduate at IIIT Tiruchirappalli, interested in building products, backend systems, and exploring how things work under the hood.

I enjoy solving problems, experimenting with ideas, and building software that's simple, reliable, and useful.

## Projects

- [Antigravity Companion](https://github.com/himanshu-gunwant/Antigravity-Companion): Cross-platform mobile workspace client and relay server for real-time synchronization and conversation management. (mobile · Flutter · Node.js)
- [Paste](https://github.com/himanshu-gunwant/Paste): Production-grade Pastebin platform backend featuring atomic burn-after-read, revision diffing, and OAuth authentication. (backend · TypeScript · PostgreSQL)
